sources.title: qwen3.8-omni-flash model information
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: exact text-output endpoint capabilities and limits remain documented; no numeric total or active model count is listed.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Exact qwen3.8-omni-flash release is explicitly dated 2026-09-17 in the Beijing, International and Global release tables. This precedes the QwenCloud September 18 entry and September 22 technical-report submission.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Omni: Towards Native Omni-Modal Agents
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, sections 2.1, 3 and 4: Thinker uses the Qwen3.8-Next sparse MoE backbone, and S1 explicitly initializes its LLM from Qwen3.8-Next parameters. S2-S4 train that backbone and enable QSA. Multi-teacher distillation consolidates specialist trajectories; no backbone resizing, pruning or expert expansion is stated. Vision, AuT and Spatial AuT are separate encoders. Vision provenance differs between sections 2.1 (Next) and 3 (Qwen3.5), so no encoder count is transferred. No direct Omni numeric count is printed.

sources.title: Model releases
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: September 18 entry explicitly says built on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next architecture. Later changelog entries through October 26 give no Omni total or active count. Architecture wording supplements the technical report's more specific LLM initialization evidence.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash: Omni Senses. Agentic Delivery.
sources.evidence: Rechecked indexed official launch article October 27; direct opening still returns an empty app shell. Article and text/vision benchmark tables contain no parameter-count column. Similar-size text performance and comparisons with Flash or Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus are not used as size evidence. Realtime and companion open-source tools remain distinct.

sources.title: Qwen public model repository query: Qwen3.8-Omni
sources.evidence: Live HTTP 200 query returned an empty array on the review date, supporting the absence of a public Qwen checkpoint under the exact model family name. This is limited to this official-organization query.

sources.title: Qwen-Omni developer guide
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: exact Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash model selection and comparison tables specify text output, modalities and context, but no total or activated parameter counts. Shared language support with Qwen3.5-Omni does not identify an equal-size model.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next official model card
sources.evidence: Accessed October 27: Language Model specification publishes nominal 125B with 6B activated, plus separate 51B n-gram embedding and 4B MTP. The benchmark table independently labels parameters, activated parameters and n-gram parameters. These supply the named base's main-language convention, not an Omni full-model count.

sources.title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
sources.evidence: Accessed October 27: report cited by Omni's initialization statement identifies Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. Abstract and Table 11 publish 125B main parameters, 6B activated, and 51B additional n-gram embeddings; the n-gram tables are outside the backbone. This connects the named initialization source to its published nominal counts.

name.note: Display-name spacing normalizes the official Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash spelling; exact API ID is qwen3.8-omni-flash.

developer.note: Released by Alibaba Cloud and its Qwen team.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit first-party public release found: September 17 in Alibaba Cloud regional/global tables. QwenCloud and the launch article show September 18; preserve that discrepancy rather than replace the earlier endpoint release with article or paper dates.

open_weights.note: The exact hosted variant is documented, but no exact released weights or explicit primary closed-weight classification was verified. A separate checkpoint or an unsuccessful repository search does not prove this variant is closed.

license.note: No exact weight artifact and corresponding license were verified for this hosted variant. API terms and other checkpoint or companion-software licenses do not establish a weight license here.

parameters_b.note: Nominal inference for main_language_model only: Omni section 3 explicitly initializes the LLM from Qwen3.8-Next, whose cited report identifies Flash-Next and publishes 125B main parameters. No subsequent backbone resizing is stated. Excludes encoders and the base's separately counted n-gram/MTP components; full Omni total remains undisclosed.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal inference for main_language_model from the explicit Next initialization and its developer-published 6B activated convention, also present in Table 11. No changed expert-routing size is stated. This does not measure complete multimodal execution or add encoder, n-gram-lookup or MTP activation.

architecture.note: Section 2.1 explicitly identifies the Thinker as hybrid sparse MoE with Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention, plus three perception encoders. Family architecture is Thinker-Talker; the Realtime speech path must not be mistaken for this text-only endpoint.

context_window.note: Official API context is 1M tokens. Input limits are separately 991808 without thinking and 983616 with thinking; neither is the total context window.

modalities.note: Exact non-Realtime endpoint outputs text only. Speech output described for Realtime does not apply here.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported and enabled by default, with adjustable reasoning effort and a non-thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Custom function calling is explicitly supported.

description.value: Qwen omni model for text, vision, audio, and multimodal agent tasks
description.note: The concise baseline description is supported by documented input modalities, analysis and agent applications; it does not claim native media output.

patch.notes: Nominal 125B main-language parameters and 6B active are inferred from the technical report's explicit Qwen3.8-Next initialization. Both counts cover the main language model only; they exclude encoders and the base's separately counted n-gram/MTP components. Full Omni total and full multimodal active count remain undisclosed. This endpoint outputs text; Realtime handles speech generation. Earliest official release-table date is September 17, 2026; the launch article shows September 18. Exact weight-release status and license remain unverified.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit found missed explicit LLM initialization in Omni report section 3. Infer nominal 125B main-language parameters and 6B active from the named Next base, with component scopes and primary-source provenance. Reviewed encoder additions and distillation; no backbone resizing is stated. Reopened launch/API guides and searched later first-party reports, cards and comparisons; none supplies a complete Omni total or multimodal active count. Other audited fields are preserved.
